description: Find people and small businesses on ME3 by what they do and where, for example a hairdresser in Galway. Returns each match with their trade, town, starting price, next free time, what they offer and their site. Give from and to dates to return only people free in that window.

country.description: Two-letter country code, such as IE.

from.description: First day they must be free (YYYY-MM-DD).

place.description: Town, region or country to look in.

query.description: What the person is looking for, such as a trade, service or product.

to.description: Last day of the window, at most 7 days after from.

type.description: Only people with services, or only with products.

name: search_people
title: Search ME3 people
